youtube.title: Free Telegram Tip? Exit Aap Ho: Pump and Dump ka Khel #Shorts
youtube.description:
Telegram par "sure-shot" stock tips ka asli khel: pump and dump. Operators pehle se shares pakad ke baithe hote hain, channel par hype karte hain, aur jab followers khareedte hain tab bech dete hain. SEBI ke Unison Metals order mein yahi pattern pakda gaya.

Is video ke numbers:
• Unison Metals case: Telegram buy calls (Dec 2021) ke dauraan bade holders ka stake ek mahine mein 17% se zyada se 2% se kam hua; ₹4.29 crore unlawful gains (SEBI order, Feb 2026, via Moneylife)
• Penalty: 17 logon par kul ₹3.65 crore, 1 se 3 saal tak market se ban
• SEBI investor caution "Pump and Dump Scam": WhatsApp/Telegram par unsolicited tips par bharosa mat karo, sirf SEBI-registered intermediaries se deal karo

Kabhi kisi Telegram group ki tip pe paisa lagaya hai? Kya hua? 👇

📌 Sirf educational content. SEBI-registered nahi. Investment advice nahi.

caption:
Free Telegram tip? Exit AAP ho 🚩

Pump and dump aise chalta hai:
1️⃣ Operator pehle se shares pakad ke baitha
2️⃣ Channel pe "BUY NOW! To the moon!"
3️⃣ Followers khareedte hain, price upar
4️⃣ Operator unhi ko bech deta hai

SEBI (Unison Metals case): bade holders ka stake 1 mahine mein 17%+ se 2% se neeche. Penalty ₹3.65 crore, 17 log ban.

Rule: anjaan group pe "pakki tip" mile toh ruko. Pehle SEBI registration check karo.
